study: MA-1163 direct pretrained weight-to-nonlinear-Mirror compilation and data-trained Mirror control
question: After independently training a viable standard NN, can its stored weights be replaced mechanically with a deterministic nonlinear recurrent K-Mirror program plus m learned physical coordinates, retaining heldout image accuracy?
prior_evidence: One-scalar mirror digit FAIL; m=1..17 direct weights ablation elsewhere. Do not change prior status.
task: sklearn load_digits handwritten 8x8 grayscale, 1797 images 10 classes; fixed dataset version as installed
split: stratified first 20% sealed test random_state=618201, remaining 20% validation random_state=618200; no audit selection
inputs: images float64 scaled pixels/16, no train-set fitted feature normalization
native_model: PyTorch float64 64->16 tanh ->10 linear; 1210 independent trainable scalars
native_optimizer: AdamW lr=0.008 weight_decay=0, batches=128, updates=900, train seeds [11,12]
native_gate: each native validation accuracy >= 0.90; if not, do not interpret Mirror accuracy
mirror_model: orthonormal deterministic seed mixing followed by 3 consecutive residual (identity+gamma*mean_K Q^{-1} tanh(Qz+b)) transforms; K=3, gamma=0.16, Q uses fixed Givens/Householder/permutation, no learned mirror codes, no teacher labels used in conversion
mirror_controls: plain deterministic orthogonal seed mixing with no nonlinear residual; same m coordinate count
direct_weight_fit_optimizer: LBFGS torch float64 strong_wolfe max_iter=150 per m; optimizer sees only pretrained network's 1210 weights, not training or heldout labels
exact_full_m_method: inverse contraction Picard iteration of each residual layer then invert fixed orthogonal seed mixing, no numerical optimization necessary; maximum 80 Picard steps per layer
direct_learning: Mirror program K=3 R=3, direct AdamW lr=0.008 updates=450 on training examples only, physical m=[16,256,1210], report separate from compilation and native baseline

audit_gates.mechanical_exact: m=1210 compiled weights max_abs_difference < 1e-9 and exact logits max_abs_difference < 1e-8 on fresh inputs
audit_gates.low_dim_compression: m<1210 must retain within 1.0 percentage point heldout test accuracy of native, and total serialized inference bytes must be smaller; also report matched nonmirror control
audit_gates.optimizer_issue: if direct gradient optimizer fails despite constructive m=1210 solution, identify optimizer/conditioning rather than representational impossibility

comparison: equal network topology and fresh test examples; independent physical trainable variables and inference memory tracked distinctly; nonlinear code source must be counted, not hidden
environment: CPU torch float64 eager one thread; sklearn 1.8.0; no GPU
forbidden_interpretations: m=1210 is compression of independent scalar count
1 learned nn.Parameter object equals one scalar
high precision bit scaling evaluated here
